description: The City of Los Angeles Bureau of Engineering publishes its storm drain pipe inventory. The schema includes line geometry, asset identifiers, upstream and downstream elevations, diameter, length, slope, material, roughness-coefficient and design-flow fields. These pipe descriptions can provide inputs for drainage-network simulation when combined with connected inlet information and hydraulic boundary conditions. An existing catalogue entry covers storm drain inlets, and the portal also exposes a map of the storm drain system. Those presentations are not assumed to be equivalent resources. Field names alone do not establish populated values, units, valid connectivity or model readiness. The provider metadata reports a November 2024 data update; current asset condition is not established. Coverage follows the provider-described Los Angeles facilities. Public catalogue pages and JSON metadata are free to access. The source specifies CC0 licensing. Data rows and export bodies were not fetched; distribution usability remains unverified. Related storm-drain inlets provide drainage entry points.
